records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the first quarter of fiscal 2025 increased 2.1% to $3.47 billion from $3.39 billion in the first quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: The increase in net sales was driven by new store openings and the contribution from Allivet, partially offset by the comparable store sales decrease of 0.9%.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the first quarter of fiscal 2025 increased 25 basis points to 36.2% from 36.0% in the first quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Operating income for the first quarter of fiscal 2025 decreased 5.3% to $249.1 million from $263.1 million in the first quarter of fiscal 2024.
